title: 第187章 《Sweet Dreams》快银的小曲
slug: 班级求生我是大客车内唯一男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

刀哥三个人瞧见地上裤管空荡荡的李沐晴时，全都僵在了原地。

难怪这小子死都不肯撒手。

合着不是为了自己，是为了这个没了腿的女生...

刀哥三人心里不由得升起愧疚感和对顾屿的敬佩。

空气安静了几秒，只有在终点前的猎人丧尸发出嘶吼声，一阵接一阵。

白毛双马尾少女坐在终点前的树干上，双手俏皮地撑在左右两侧，还翘起指尖。

红色魔术外套的宽袖垂了下来，和白色双马尾一起随风飘荡。

一双裸足优雅地交叠在一起，玉iiOiiO欢快地前后摆动。

她很开心，很兴奋，因为有一场好戏要开演了！

可红色狐狸面具下，少女原本是一副吃瓜看好戏的表情，当看到李沐晴摔下小货车，并对着顾屿摆出‘家’的手语后，少女晃动iiOiiO停住了。

一滴泪水从她眼角滑落。

少女忽然想起那个失聪的姐姐。

那个傻傻的、笨笨的，却总是护着自己的姐姐。

少女嘴角轻轻勾起。

但没事！

姐姐已经成为了自己的观众！

刀哥看着坐在地上的李沐晴，又看了看死死咬着牙并红了眼的顾屿。

刀哥闭着眼，深吸一口气，忽然睁开眼怒喝道：

“别他妈看了！动手！老四要不行了！”

“我们几个烂命一条，死了就死了！可老四还有老娘要养！”

老二老三对视一眼，咬了咬牙，手上再次加了力道。

从穿越到现在，老四都救过他们三个人的命。

要不是当过兵的老四在，他们三人早死了。

更何况，刀哥他们三人的家人都没了，没有牵挂，活一天赚一天。

死了就死了，反正烂人一个。

可老四绝不能死！

他是报效过祖国的人。

他还有老娘等着他回去。

他必须活下来！！

刀哥再次掰断顾屿的一根手指，并朝着顾屿咬牙切齿地一个字一个字吐出来：

“对不住了！我兄弟绝不能死！！”

顾屿嘴里爆发出一声怒吼：

“我槽尼玛！！”

“你兄弟不能死，我女友就该死吗？！！”

顾屿疯了似的挣扎起来，仰起头就想继续去咬摁着自己的手。

可偷车贼老三早就有预料，直接一手摁住顾屿的头。

刀哥看着还在挣扎的顾屿，心一横，直接高举右手，手掌成刀，瞄准顾屿的咽喉正中。

他很清楚，这个部位是致死位，一旦自己真的全力砸下去，顾屿几秒内就会窒息晕厥，再重一点能直接没命！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When Brother Dao and the three of them saw Li Muqing with empty pants on the ground, they all froze in place.

No wonder this kid refused to let go until his death.

I co-wrote it not for myself, but for this girl who has lost her legs...

Brother Dao and the other three couldn't help but feel guilty and admire Gu Yu.

The air was quiet for a few seconds, and only the hunter zombies in front of the finish line roared one after another.

The girl with white hair and double ponytails sat on the tree trunk in front of the finish line, her hands playfully placed on her left and right sides, and her fingertips raised.

The wide sleeves of the red magic jacket hung down, and they fluttered in the wind together with the white twin ponytails.

A pair of bare feet elegantly overlap each other, and the jade swaying back and forth happily.

She was very happy and excited because a good show was about to begin!

But under the red fox mask, the girl originally looked like she was enjoying the show. When she saw Li Muqing falling out of the pickup truck and making a 'home' sign language to Gu Yu, the girl stopped shaking iiOiiO.

A tear slipped from the corner of her eye.

The girl suddenly thought of her deaf sister.

That silly, clumsy, but always protective sister.

The corners of the girl's mouth curled up slightly.

But it’s okay!

My sister has become her own audience!

Brother Dao looked at Li Muqing who was sitting on the ground, and then at Gu Yu who was gritting his teeth and his eyes were red.

Brother Dao closed his eyes, took a deep breath, suddenly opened his eyes and shouted angrily:

"Stop fucking looking at it! Take action! The fourth child is dying!"

"We have only one life. If we die, we will die! But the fourth child still has a mother to support!"

The second and third children looked at each other, gritted their teeth, and increased their strength on their hands again.

From time to time until now, the fourth child has saved the lives of three of them.

If it weren't for the presence of the fourth child who had served as a soldier, the three of them would have died long ago.

What's more, Brother Dao and the three of them have no family members. They have no worries and can only make money one day at a time.

If you die, you will die. Anyway, you are a rotten person.

But the fourth child must not die!

He is a man who has served his motherland.

He still has his wife waiting for him to return.

He must survive!!

Brother Dao once again broke off one of Gu Yu's fingers, and gritted his teeth and spat out each word at Gu Yu:

"I'm sorry! My brother must not die!!"

A roar burst out from Gu Yu's mouth:

"I'm sorry!!"

"If your brother can't die, should my girlfriend die?!!"

Gu Yu struggled like crazy, raised his head and wanted to continue biting the hand that was holding him down.

But the car thief Lao San had already predicted this and directly held Gu Yu's head with one hand.

Brother Dao looked at Gu Yu who was still struggling, his heart skipped a beat, he raised his right hand high, turned his palm into a knife, and aimed it at the center of Gu Yu's throat.

He knew very well that this part was the fatal position. Once he really hit it with all his strength, Gu Yu would suffocate and faint within a few seconds. If it were harder, he would be killed!
